name: Cap
summary: Open-source Loom alternative for screen recording, editing and shareable video links.
description: Cap records your screen, camera and microphone and shares it as a link or export; an open-source Loom alternative with desktop apps for macOS and Windows plus a web dashboard. Instant Mode uploads while recording, Studio Mode edits locally with backgrounds, zooms, captions and trimming. Share links carry comments, reactions, transcripts and viewer analytics; recordings can live in Cap Cloud, your own S3 bucket, locally or on a fully self-hosted deployment.
contains: records screen, camera and microphone; Instant and Studio recording modes
desktop apps for macOS and Windows plus a web dashboard
share links with comments, reactions, transcripts and viewer analytics
AI titles, summaries, clickable chapters, captions and transcripts
storage: Cap Cloud, your own S3 (R2, B2, MinIO ...), local or self-hosted
self-hosting via Docker Compose, Railway or Coolify; Loom video importer
pricing: free for personal use; Desktop $29/year; Cap Pro $12/user/month
AGPL-3.0 license (cap-camera and scap crates MIT)
